Chapter 424 - 424 Guidance; Living In The Library?

Chapter 424 - 424 Guidance; Living in the Library?

424 Guidance; Living in the Library?

Qiu Junxiong and Liu Wei did all the steps of the experiment in a stable manner.

Normally, the experiment would normally take half an hour to complete, but it took an hour before it gradually came to an end.

“Professor Lin, what do you think needs to be improved?” Liu Wei asked.

Qiu Junxiong and the graduate students all looked at Lin Fan with anticipation.

They had been working on the body sensing equipment for more than a year.

However, they encountered many difficulties.

They were all looking forward to Lin Fan, who was like a god, being able to provide them with some help.

However…

Lin Fan did not answer them immediately.

Instead, he placed his attention on the system mission.

[Mission: Watch a biology experiment (0/1) and a computer experiment (1/1). Read Nervous System Research, From Neuron to Brain, The Constitution of Neuron, Nervous Transmission, Animation, Mathematical Methods in 3D Games and Computer Images, and Game Program Patterns. Reward: Computer and biology experience increases by one level, gaming helmet, and its working principles.]

He had completed one of the requirements!

After a while, Lin Fan retracted his attention and said, “Your experiment has inspired me. I’ll go back and organize my thoughts first.”

Without waiting for Qiu Junxiong and Liu Wei to speak, he turned around and walked out.

Then, he went straight to Teaching Building No. 2.

Most of the laboratories in the biology department were located here.

Lin Fan had been here once. With his photographic memory, he was familiar with the entire building.

He came to the laboratory door on the third floor and pushed it open.

Professor Zheng Qian, Professor Wu, and a few other graduate students were studying something.

After a long period of research, Zheng Qian’s mouth was a little dry.

She got up and was about to get some water to drink.

The next moment, Zheng Qian was stunned.

She said in surprise, “Lin… Professor Lin, when did you arrive?”

As soon as she said this…

Wu Tian, who was originally doing experiments seriously, and a few graduate students all stopped what they were doing and looked toward the door.

When they saw that it was Lin Fan, Wu Tian hurriedly went up to him. He bowed slightly and said excitedly, “Professor Lin, the recovery drug you invented is amazing!

“Even though we’ve studied the paper repeatedly, we still find many parts of it amazing!”

The more Wu Tian spoke, the more excited he became. His old face, which had experienced some vicissitudes of life, became extremely red.

Wu Tian continued, “In fact, even following the steps in the thesis, some experiments are still difficult for us to complete… Mr. Lin, can you give us some guidance?”

At this point, Wu Tian’s face was filled with anticipation.

After Lin Fan published the paper Principles of the Human Islet Recovery Drug, Wu Tian and Zheng Qian became famous in the biology world.

However, they did not become arrogant because of this.

On the contrary, Wu Tian and Zheng Qian spent a lot of time researching the drug.

In the outside world, many people thought that Wu Tian and Zheng Qian had done a lot of research on the drug.

However, in fact, the knowledge they had was not much different from that of the biologists who studied glucose.

This meant that even if they spent a lot of time, their progress might not be much faster than those biologists.

When Lin Fan heard Wu Tian’s words, his gaze changed.

Guide an experiment?

It should be considered as watching a biology experiment, right?

Thinking of this, Lin Fan said, “Okay, but my time is limited. I’ll guide you in an experiment.”

“Thank you, Professor Lin!” Wu Tian said happily.

The last time Lin Fan completed the system mission, he directly obtained the manufacturing principle of the drug. As for the various experiments involved, he naturally understood them very well.

With Lin Fan’s help, a complete biology experiment was completed in just 40 minutes.

“So that’s how it is!” Wu Tian said in realization. “No wonder we couldn’t succeed before!”

Zheng Qian and the other graduate students had a look of reminiscence on their faces.

Lin Fan did not bother about it and focused on the system mission.

[Mission: Watch a biological experiment (1/1) and a computer experiment (1/1). Read Nervous System Research, From Neuron to Brain, The Constitution of Neuron, Nervous Transmission, Animation, Mathematical Methods in 3D Games and Computer Images, and Game Program Patterns. Reward: Computer and biology experience increases by one level, gaming helmet, and its working principles.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s lips curled up.

As expected, even if he was just guiding the experiment, he could still complete the task.

“Professor Lin, thank you for your guidance.”

Zheng Qian and a few other graduate students followed, “Professor Lin, thank you for your guidance.”

Lin Fan waved his hand. “It’s just a small matter. You guys can continue your research. I’ll take my leave first.”

After saying that, he turned around and left.

Then, Lin Fan strode into the library.

After all, he only needed to read a few more books and he would soon be able to get a gaming helmet.

At this moment, a clear voice rang out not far away.

“You’re here?”

Lin Fan looked in the direction of the voice. It was Lu Ling!

Today, Lu Ling was wearing a long blue dress. Her quiet face, snow-white skin, and the books in her arms made her look extremely quiet and pure.

Lin Fan could not help but feel weird. “Yeah.”

Almost every time he came to the library, he would meet Lu Lin. Why did it feel like she lived here?

Finally, Lin Fan could not help but ask the question in his heart, “You seem to always be in the library. Don’t tell me you live here?”

Lu Ling’s snow-white face blushed slightly. Then, she said in a somewhat reproachful tone, “I have no choice. When I heard that the famous Professor Lin Fan was recruiting students, I hurriedly sent an email, but I wasn’t selected.

“So, I can only stay in the library, study hard, and continue my postgraduate studies.”

When Lin Fan heard this, he could not help but reveal an awkward expression. “You sent an email? I might not have noticed.”

When he was recruiting students, Lin Fan received tens of thousands of emails.

Therefore, he asked Lil White to pick ten students from each field who had the most potential and were the most outstanding.

Lu Ling always had difficulty answering even simple questions. It was normal that she was not picked as one of the top ten physics students.
